title: Cable Cars, Waterfalls, and a Stranger Named Dede
excerpt: I rode the Langkawi SkyCab above the rainforest canopy, crossed the world's longest curved sky bridge, and ended up spending the whole day with a French woman I met in a queue — proof that losing internet can be the best thing that happens to you.

photos.alt: Two travelers smiling in a selfie in front of a large granite rock face with thin waterfalls trickling down, dense jungle behind them
The multi-storey white facade of Adya Hotel in Langkawi seen from the street, framed by trees and an ornate street lamp under a clear blue sky
A white latticed tower resembling a minaret rises above leafy trees and shophouses in Langkawi town against a blue sky with fluffy clouds
A tall glass of deep-pink iced rose milk with a pink straw on a red café table, a bright shopfront visible through the window behind
Chicken murtabak — golden pan-fried flatbread stuffed with spiced chicken — cut into pieces on a steel plate with three dipping sauces
Oriental Village at Langkawi SkyCab: an arched white footbridge over a lily-covered pond, flanked by red-roofed huts and tall palm trees under a blue sky
Two Langkawi SkyCab gondolas gliding above dense green rainforest with the turquoise Andaman Sea and small islands stretching to the horizon
Langkawi SkyBridge — a curved steel pedestrian bridge suspended between two mountain peaks by a single pylon, crowds of visitors walking across it above the jungle
Entrance arch to Telaga Tujuh (Seven Wells) waterfall in Langkawi, Kedah, Malaysia, with terracotta pillars topped by stone bowls and a brick path leading inside
A rainforest trail head at Seven Wells with an information board, picnic bench, and smooth granite boulders in the foreground surrounded by dense tropical vegetation

View from the top of Seven Wells waterfall: smooth granite rock pools in the foreground, a wide valley of rainforest, the Andaman Sea gleaming blue on the horizon, and the SkyCab tower on a ridge to the right
Dusk at Tanjung Rhu Beach: two jagged limestone sea stacks silhouetted against a moody sky with orange clouds reflected on calm silver water
A creamy coconut shake in a plastic cup with a yellow straw on a dark wood table at an open-air beachside restaurant, red plastic chairs blurred in the background
